Maya Patel: Follow-up from PM: two recurring failure modes we flagged -> (A) cloud auth token TTL spikes from provider-side throttling leading to mass refresh storms, (B) model-registry leader election / write stall patterns under transient IO pressure. Need concrete owners + short timeline.
Jordan Lee: Agreed. Propose three lanes: 1) immediate mitigation (config + runbook), 2) telemetry/alerts + synthetic checks, 3) vendor SLA & architectural hardening.
Priya Nair: I'll own vendor lane. Action: open a formal RCA request with provider, ask for token refresh throttling logs and request a PoC change to refresh backoff at their edge. ETA: vendor outreach by Thu.
Jordan Lee: I'll own immediate mitigations: implement per-client retry budget (max_retries=3, jittered backoff), and add write-backpressure so registry returns 429 early if queue depth > threshold. Will post PR. ETA: 48h.
Maya Patel: Telemetry work — need a P90/P99 write latency spike alert, auth refresh-success-rate per-region, and a weekly trend dashboard that correlates provider-side throttles with our retry bursts. Who can add?
Jordan Lee: I'll add metrics: registry.write.queue_len, registry.write.rejection_count, auth.refresh.rate_success.
Priya Nair: I'll add alerts for auth.refresh.rate_success < 97% for 10m and registry.write.rejection_count > 50 in 5m. Also will schedule a weekly "recurrence review" with ops + product.
Maya Patel: Runbook snippet (short):
```
- If auth.refresh.rate_success < 97% for 10m -> page infra oncall
- Infra oncall: enable token-pad (extend local token TTL by +30s) and turn on client-side retry budget
- If registry.write.queue_len > 500 -> enable write-throttle (route low-priority requests to degraded mode)
- Escalate to Priya (vendor lead) if vendor logs show throttling behavior
```
Jordan Lee: I'll add a small heartbeat that writes a tiny model-tag every 15m and validates token exchange; failure -> auto-create INC-2801. Should be a 1-2h patch.
infra-bot: Auto-created ticket INC-2801: "registry-synthetic-heartbeat-and-retry-budget". Link: https://issues.redwood/INC-2801
Priya Nair: Vendor ask draft: request log slices for refresh storms on dates X/Y/Z, ask for any rate-limiting config at their auth edge, propose adding a 2s per-customer refresh spread. I'll attach the logs we collected.
Maya Patel: Ownership summary:
- Immediate retry budget + backpressure: Jordan (owner)
- Alerts + dashboards + synthetic: Jordan (owner)
- Vendor engagement & SLA ask: Priya (owner)
- Incident tracking & follow-up meeting: Maya (owner)
Maya Patel: Timelines: immediate fixes 48h, alerts + synthetic 72h, vendor outreach Thu, follow-up recurrence review next Monday 11am PT. If anyone needs to swap, ping in-thread.
Jordan Lee: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pull/1299 (retry budget + throttle). WIP, test failures on k8s env.
Priya Nair: Vendor ticket opened: VND-7421. Added initial evidence bundle.
Maya Patel: Good. After we close INC-2801 and confirm the synthetic's run for a week, we'll decide on longer-term steps (regional active-passive registry, cross-region token mirrors). For now, keep updates here. :eyes:
